title: BUDGET-TRANSFER: does the fitted widener survive a change of ROSTER? (zero calls; the x12 parameters applied COLD to the 20-model board)
question: SYSTEMATIC-BUDGET ships tau(A) = exp(-3.2326 + 3.3133 A) on one roster; x20 carries 12,394 cached verdicts over 20 models, all keyed. plain_description.what: Takes the formula that decides when a pairwise ranking call is confident enough, fitted on the 12-model board, and applies it unchanged to new pairs on the 20-model board. It counts how often the confident calls point the wrong way. No judge calls.
plain_description.why: Checks whether the confidence formula still works when the set of models changes, or only fits the roster it was trained on.
plain_description.information: Error rates at or below the promised level would mean the formula transfers. Higher rates would mean it must be refitted for each roster. Result: undetermined, as the registration expected. There were only 2 confirmed wrong calls against about 1.6 expected, which is too few to decide. The formula still made 70% of the possible calls. Two earlier, opposite readings were withdrawn. The formula is published as fitted to one roster, with transfer untested. Later ruled history rather than evidence, because it ran on the older question pool.
